words.meaning: A mass of snow, ice, and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside.
words.sentence1: The heavy snowfall triggered a massive avalanche in the high peaks. (The heavy snowfall triggered a massive avalanche in the high peaks.)
words.sentence2: Climbers must always check conditions for an avalanche before ascending. (Climbers must always check conditions for an avalanche before ascending.)

words.meaning: A waterfall, typically one of several or falling down in stages.
words.sentence1: La cascada fluye con fuerza despues de la tormenta de verano. (The waterfall flows strongly after the summer storm.)
words.sentence2: Escuchamos el sonido de la cascada desde muy lejos en el bosque. (We heard the sound of the waterfall from far away in the forest.)

words.meaning: A period of extended and exceptionally hot weather during summer.
words.sentence1: La canicule estivale assoiffe les plantes et desseche les rivieres. (The summer heatwave makes plants thirsty and dries up rivers.)
words.sentence2: Pendant la canicule, nous cherchons la fraicheur sous les grands arbres. (During the heatwave, we seek coolness under the tall trees.)

words.meaning: Light coming directly from the sun, especially during the day.
words.sentence1: Der warme Sonnenschein weckt die bunten Blumen im Fruehling. (The warm sunshine awakens the colorful flowers in spring.)
words.sentence2: Wir geniessen den goldenen Sonnenschein bei einem Spaziergang im Wald. (We enjoy the golden sunshine during a walk in the forest.)

words.meaning: Frozen precipitation that falls in white flakes from clouds during winter.
words.sentence1: Fuyu no asa, yama wa shiroi yuki de ooimawareta. (On a winter morning, the mountains were covered in white snow.)
words.sentence2: Kodomotachi wa niwa de tsumetai yuki wo sagashite asondeiru. (The children are playing in the garden looking for cold snow.)

words.meaning: A slowly moving mass or river of ice formed by the accumulation and compaction of snow on mountains or near the poles.
words.sentence1: Il maestoso ghiacciaio splende sotto il sole della montagna. (The majestic glacier shines under the mountain sun.)
words.sentence2: Ogni anno il ghiacciaio perde parte della sua antica neve invernale. (Every year the glacier loses part of its ancient winter snow.)

words.meaning: The land along the edge of a sea or ocean.
words.sentence1: Xiatian de haian chongman le haiou he langhua de shengxiao. (The summer coast is filled with the sounds of seagulls and splashing waves.)
words.sentence2: Women zai meili de haian shang kan zhe riqi luo. (We are watching the sunset on the beautiful coast.)

words.meaning: A vibrant colored floral blossom, often symbolizing spring or seasonal awakening.
words.sentence1: Bomnarui ttatteuthan haessal arae pulkcotdeuri hwamakhage pieotda. (Under the warm spring sunlight, colorful flowers bloomed brilliantly.)
words.sentence2: Sanchaekroeseo gajakgajakhan pulkcotui hyanggireul neukkyeotda. (I felt the fragrant scent of the flowers along the walking path.)

words.meaning: A wild animal or rabbit often associated with the rural landscape and nature.
words.sentence1: Tonsay loy mukh tov chork chea muoy chkae trong phteah prey. (The wild rabbit runs quickly into the forest grass.)
words.sentence2: Yur kanh chkout tonsay domraong pheak roy chea chmouh srok. (We often see small rabbits running through the green fields.)

words.meaning: The night sky filled with bright stars visible during clear weather.
words.sentence1: Op 'n helder aand kan mens die pragtige sterrewag bo die berg sien. (On a clear evening, one can see the magnificent starry sky above the mountain.)
words.sentence2: Die stilte van die sterrewag bring rus vir die natuur in die nag. (The silence of the starry sky brings peace to nature at night.)
